newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hundreds evacuated as fire hits north Marseille.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds evacuated as fire hits north Marseille.

text.p: About a thousand people were evacuated from northern districts in the Mediterranean port city of Marseille on Friday as a fire destroyed more than 600 hectares of forest and scrubland, officials said.
Strong wind fanned the fire, the biggest in four years, which started around noon (1000 GMT) in a rubbish dump near a pine forest in the Marseille suburb of Septemes-les-Vallons.
Five villas were burnt down and the local fire brigade lost seven of its vehicles to the flames.
A total of 700 people using light aircraft, a helicopter and fire-engines battled to put out the blaze. Weather forecasters expected strong winds to continue throughout the night.
Seven firemen and a policeman were slightly injured and some 50 people needed treatment for smoke inhalation.
